title: Two-Regime Risk Measures under Convex Loss
abstract: arXiv:2610.08821v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study a two-regime summary of a real-valued loss distribution. The two representative levels and the boundary between them are chosen by minimizing a convex residual loss. When the distribution has an atom at the boundary, assigning that atom to the lower or upper regime can give different optimized costs. Taking the better whole-atom assignment yields the lower-semicontinuous cutoff profile. We prove epi-convergence of this profile under a loss-adapted \(\psi\)-weak topology and obtain convergence of minimum values and outer stability of optimal cutoff sets. Under a unique finite atom-free limiting cutoff, positive regime masses, and unique conditional centers, the two fitted levels and a canonical one-jump representation converge as well. translated_title: 凸损失下的双区制风险度量
translated_abstract: 我们研究实值损失分布的一种双区制摘要方法。两个代表性水平以及二者之间的边界通过最小化凸残差损失来选取。当分布在边界处存在原子时，将该原子分配到下区制或上区制可能产生不同的最优成本；取较优的整体原子分配方式可得到下半连续的截断轮廓。我们在损失自适应的 \(\psi\)-弱拓扑下证明了该轮廓的 epi-收敛性，并得到最小值的收敛性以及最优截断集的外部稳定性。在唯一的有限无原子极限截断、各区制质量为正以及条件中心唯一的条件下，两个拟合水平以及典范的单跳表示也同样收敛。我们还从货币风险公理的角度考察所得的摘要，明确证明了外部单调性与次可加性的失效，并给出有限支撑情形下的算法及其……
tldr: 本文提出通过最小化凸残差损失来构造损失分布双区制摘要的风险度量方法，证明了截断轮廓在损失自适应弱拓扑下的epi-收敛性与最优截断集的稳定性，并从货币风险公理角度揭示其外部单调性与次可加性的失效，同时给出有限支撑算法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-regime summary of loss distributions obtained by minimizing a convex residual loss, proves epi-convergence of the resulting lower-semicontinuous cutoff profile under a loss-adapted ψ-weak topology, reveals failures of external monotonicity and subadditivity from the perspective of monetary risk axioms, and provides finite-support algorithms.
